zh.explain: 梧桐落叶，秋天即将过完，归程顺畅快如云飞。感谢天公赐予洪福，才这么一帆风顺，满载财宝而归。
divination: 心中所盼望的事情，上天一定会满足。
至于经营谋生之类的事情，则尽可大胆地放手去做。
zh.summary: 此卦梧桐叶落之象。所祈求之事先有凶险，之后会吉祥。

verse: As autumn leaves fell from phoenix trees,
The travellers journey home like fleeting clouds.
Thankful for the blessings from almighty Heavens,
A ship laden with treasures sails with good winds.
interpretation: Your intention will be supported by Heavens.
Carry out your tasks and duties to the best of your efforts.
meaning: Things may initially appear unfavorable but will eventually turn well.
en.explain: Leaves have fallen from the sycamore tree, signifying autumn is about to end, travellers return home smoothly like the flying clouds. Thanks to the almighty heavenly deity for the blessings, so that the ship can return home so smoothly, laden with treasures.
divination: Whatever one wishes, it will be fulfilled by Heaven. For matters relating to running your own business, be courageous and do your best.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings
Increase your wealth & wisdom by reprinting Buddhist scriptures
Have results after your own heart
Able to use your talents & be appreciated

notes: Both pages omit the 寻失物 / 'Missing things' item (17 items, not 18) and include extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. zh key printed 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. 'The travellers journey' printed without apostrophe.
